def find_original_message(t):
    n = len(t)
    
    # Check if the entire string is repeated exactly once
    if t == t[:n//2] * 2:
        return "YES\n" + t[:n//2]
    
    # Dynamic programming approach to find the longest valid substring
    dp = [0] * n
    max_len = 0
    end_index = -1
    
    for i in range(1, n):
        j = dp[i-1]
        while j > 0 and t[i] != t[j]:
            j = dp[j-1]
        
        if t[i] == t[j]:
            j += 1
        
        dp[i] = j
        if j > max_len:
            max_len = j
            end_index = i
    
    if max_len == 0:
        return "NO"
    
    original_message = t[:end_index-max_len+1]
    return "YES\n" + original_message
